claim: A probation period can last up to three months.
A probation period can last up to six months.
During probation either side can end the contract with three working days' notice.
Overtime is capped at 180 hours per year.
Overtime is capped at 250 hours per year.
Overtime on public holidays is paid at double the hourly rate.
Employees get at least 20 working days of paid leave.
All employees get 25 working days of paid leave.
The employer pays 80 percent of average pay for the first two sick days.
The employer pays full salary for the first two sick days.
Breaches must be reported to the Inspectorate within 72 hours where feasible.
Breaches must be reported within 24 hours.
The regulator has to be told about a leak of personal data promptly, generally inside three days.

Fines are limited to 10 million euros.
Workplace CCTV footage may be stored for at most 30 days unless needed as evidence.
Cameras are allowed in changing rooms if employees are informed.

Online buyers can cancel within 30 days.
Sellers are liable for defects appearing within two years of delivery.
Defects in the first year are presumed to have existed at delivery.
The guarantee lasts one year.
A security deposit cannot be more than two months' rent.
The landlord can keep the deposit for normal wear and tear.
Landlords must give a day's warning before visiting the flat.

A private limited company needs at least 2,500 euros of share capital.

Directors of an insolvent company have 90 days to file for bankruptcy.
